title: Sunday School
sum: Bible classes for every age, from the youngest children to adults, before the worship service.

title: Music Ministry
sum: The choir, cantatas and special numbers that lift up the Lord in song.

title: Worship & Preaching
sum: Sound preaching from the King James Bible and congregational singing from the hymnal, with special numbers from our choir.

title: Prayer Meetings
sum: The church gathers to pray for one another, for the lost, and for the missionaries we support.

title: Saturation
sum: Teams go house to house in the barangays around us, sharing the Gospel and inviting families to church.

title: Extension Classes
sum: Bible classes held in nearby communities, teaching children and families the Word of God where they live.

title: Youth
sum: Fellowship, Bible study and camps that help our young people grow in the Lord and serve Him.

title: Missions
sum: Through prayer and faithful giving, the church supports missionaries in the Philippines and around the world.
